dct_title_s: North Pacific Ocean : West coast of North America between latitudes 51°30' and 55°30'N : Embracing the Queen Charlotte Islands : Hecate Strait and Dixon Entrance
dct_description_sm: From British and United States surveys ; published Apr, 1883, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by hachures and spot heights.
Shows coastal relief, waterways, low water areas, various place names, islands, lights, currents.
Descriptive text, such as "bare white rocks," "brown sand," "tides meet about here with slight variations."
